data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

NASA’s sample-caching rover, on Mars since February 2021. Carried Ingenuity, the first off-Earth helicopter; has collected 33 of 43 sample tubes for eventual return to Earth. Looking for biosignatures in Jezero Crater’s ancient delta.
First helicopter on another planet (Ingenuity); first sample caching on Mars
Twin to Spirit; nearly 15-year Mars operation
Proposed NASA rover for the lunar south pole

Designed to cache promising rock cores for a future Mars Sample Return mission. Already drilled and sealed 26+ samples by mid-2024. The Ingenuity helicopter — originally a 30-day technology demo — flew 72 times before damaging a rotor in January 2024. First powered, controlled flight on another world.
